changeSet.sql: create table dateinamen_regel ( nr int primary key constraint dateinamen_regel_nr_ck check (nr > 0), muster text not null constraint dateinamen_regel_muster_ck check (length(muster) between 1 and 1000), art text not null constraint dateinamen_regel_art_fk references dokumentart (code), felder jsonb not null constraint dateinamen_regel_felder_ck check (jsonb_typeof(felder) = 'object') ); create table belegnummer_alias ( art text not null constraint belegnummer_alias_art_fk references dokumentart (code), alias text not null constraint belegnummer_alias_alias_ck check (length(alias) between 1 and 100), belegnummer text not null constraint belegnummer_alias_belegnummer_ck check (length(belegnummer) between 1 and 100), erstellt_von text not null, zeit timestamptz not null, primary key (art, alias) ); alter table dokument add column dateiname_regel jsonb;
